name: Old Wullie, Firth Pilot

intro.text: Sixty years I've piloted boats through the Pentland Firth. Never lost a boat. Lost a lot of hats. Come on, then, let's see if you can read the water.

win: Well I'll be. You've the Firth in you after all.
after: My granny told me the Stoor Worm's teeth fell out and made Orkney, Shetland and Faroe, and its body curled up and became Iceland. Assipattle killed it with a burning peat in its liver. Every word true, she said. She also said the moon was made of crowdie.
